President Murmu Addresses Nation on Eve of Independence Day

President Droupadi Murmu addressed the nation on the eve of India's 80th Independence Day. She recalled the struggle for independence, the pain of partition, and India's development journey. The President paid tribute to freedom fighters and highlighted the government's steps to prevent paper leaks and reform examinations. Her address focused on the nation's progress and extended greetings for Independence Day.
